name: Observatorul Urseanu (tower and dome)

sources.label: OSM w1220336122 · building:part=yes (the round east tower), no height
District dossier: Observatorul Astronomic Amiral Vasile Urseanu
Fidelity pass round 3 (2b1a251), not yet published when captured

improvements: The round east tower of the Urseanu observatory is a cream rounded corner bay with iron balcony bands at the villa's three-storey height (13.5 m), topped by a grey hemispherical observatory dome with a shutter slit. It replaces the 25.6 m blank default cylinder of its own building:part only.
remainingGaps: 13.5 m comes from the storey count; the dome is blurred on the panorama, so its radius, rise and grey metal finish are estimates of the usual observatory dome.

From the street at the reference panorama's pose the dome is hidden behind the tower's own parapet and the street trees, so the district picture is an elevated view (40 m above the street) from the east; it is not a street-level comparison.
